BUSI 100.title: Micro Foundations of Real Estate Economics
BUSI 100.description: Basic principles of microeconomics and application to current economic problems.

BUSI 101.title: Capital Markets and Real Estate
BUSI 101.description: Basic principles of macroeconomics and application to current economic problems.

BUSI 111.title: British Columbia Real Estate Law and Real Estate Ethics
BUSI 111.description: Canadian legal system and contract law and detailed aspects of real estate law as it applies in British Columbia.

BUSI 112.title: Canadian Real Property Law and Real Estate Ethics
BUSI 112.description: Canadian legal system and contract law and detailed aspects of real estate law as it applies across Canada.

BUSI 121.title: Foundations of Real Estate Mathematics
BUSI 121.description: Introduction to mathematics of real estate finance and statistical measures and methods and their application to practical real estate concepts.

BUSI 221.title: Real Estate Finance in a Canadian Context
BUSI 221.description: History, function and mechanics of Canadian mortgage markets.

BUSI 290.title: Introduction to Quantitative Decision Analysis
BUSI 290.description: Introduction to decision models in business, including basic optimization, linear programming, probability, decision analysis, random variables, simulation, and solving decision problems using spreadsheet tools.

BUSI 291.title: Application of Statistics in Business
BUSI 291.description: Methods and applications of statistics in business; data analysis, descriptive regression; data generation; sampling distributions; hypothesis testing; confidence intervals; two sample problems; inference in regression.

BUSI 293.title: Introductory Financial Accounting
BUSI 293.description: Introduction to the construction and interpretation of financial reports prepared primarily for external use.

BUSI 294.title: Introductory Management Accounting
BUSI 294.description: Introduction to the development and use of accounting information for management planning and control, and the development of cost information for financial reports.

BUSI 295.title: Business Economics
BUSI 295.description: Introduction to microeconomics and macroeconomics principles with applications to accounting and business decision making.

BUSI 299.title: Business Communications
BUSI 299.description: Basic communication theory, communications in organizations. Includes written and oral practice in lab sessions.

BUSI 300.title: Urban and Real Estate Economics
BUSI 300.description: Comprehensive treatment of urban and real estate economics; introduction to study of cities and real estate market; analytical microeconomic principles.

BUSI 329.title: Principles of Organizational Behaviour
BUSI 329.description: An introductory examination of work organizations and the behaviour of individuals within them. Phenomena to be studied include organizational structure, environments, group processes, motivation and leadership.

BUSI 330.title: Foundations of Real Estate Appraisal
BUSI 330.description: Introduction to concepts and techniques for appraising the value of real estate. Recommended prerequisite: BUSI_V 121.

BUSI 331.title: Real Estate Investment Analysis and Advanced Income Appraisal
BUSI 331.description: Valuation techniques for income real estate, including income method of appraisal, tax consequences of real property ownership, and portfolio analysis methodology.

BUSI 335.title: Information Systems
BUSI 335.description: Introduction to information technology related to business use: design, implementation, and application of information systems.

BUSI 344.title: Statistical and Computer Applications in Valuation
BUSI 344.description: Explores creative, practical uses of statistical and computer applications in determining and analyzing real estate value. Through case studies and hands-on computer work, students will learn the fundamentals of exploratory data analysis and appraisal valuation modelling.

BUSI 352.title: Case Studies in Residential Valuation
BUSI 352.description: Examines common issues that affect the practice of residential real estate valuation.

BUSI 353.title: Intermediate Financial Accounting I
BUSI 353.description: An examination of accounting as a means of measurement and as an information system for external reporting purposes.

BUSI 354.title: Cost Accounting
BUSI 354.description: The provision and analysis of cost accounting information that will assist management in making operating decisions and in evaluating operational performance.

BUSI 355.title: Introduction to Income Tax
BUSI 355.description: A study of income tax from the standpoint of the individual and business enterprise.

BUSI 370.title: Business Finance
BUSI 370.description: An introduction to the basic principles of financial valuation and an examination of corporate enterprise decisions including working capital management; capital budgeting; capital structures and dividend policy.

BUSI 391.title: Introduction to Management Information Systems
BUSI 391.description: Overview of computer technology and terminology; use of computers as managerial and administrative tools; the management of computer resources and the influence of information technology within the organization.

BUSI 393.title: Introduction to Business Law
BUSI 393.description: Introduction to the law of contracts, with particular reference to contracts for sale of goods and related law of personal property, principles of agency, partnership, and company law.

BUSI 398.title: Residential Property Guided Case Study
BUSI 398.description: The residential property appraisal process, focusing both on valuation techniques as well as general research and report writing skills.

BUSI 399.title: Logistics and Operations Management
BUSI 399.description: The design and management of systems to make products, provide services and deliver them to the end user.
BUSI 399.prerequisiteText: All of BUSI_V 290, BUSI_V 291 or equivalents

BUSI 400.title: Residential Property Analysis
BUSI 400.description: Underlying theory and techniques used in design, construction, and inspection of residential properties.

BUSI 401.title: Commercial Property Analysis
BUSI 401.description: Underlying theory and techniques used in the design and construction of commercial properties.

BUSI 414.title: Data Visualization and Business Analytics
BUSI 414.description: Builds critical thinking and data skills by identifying statistical pitfalls, cleaning data with Power Query, creating financial models, and crafting impactful visualizations using Power BI and Excel to support decision-making through practical applications.

BUSI 433.title: Real Estate Business
BUSI 433.description: General business skills for real estate practitioners.

BUSI 441.title: Real Estate Management I
BUSI 441.description: Examines the day-to-day issues which affect the practice of property management.

BUSI 442.title: Case Studies in Appraisal I
BUSI 442.description: Examines the day-to-day issues that affect the practice of real estate appraisal.

BUSI 443.title: Assessment Administration
BUSI 443.description: Introduces the practice of real property assessment, including the nature of the techniques used, the required duties of assessors, and how an assessment office is administrated. Recommended prerequisite: BUSI_V 330.

BUSI 444.title: Computer Aided Mass Property Assessment
BUSI 444.description: This course develops and applies the major techniques for valuing real property. Recommended prerequisites: All of BUSI_V 121, BUSI_V 330, BUSI_V 443.

BUSI 445.title: Real Estate Development I
BUSI 445.description: Real estate development process from the project idea to the cursory feasibility stage. Steps in development planning, including analysis, design and evaluation. Evaluating development potential, land acquisition, and site planning.

BUSI 446.title: Real Estate Development II
BUSI 446.description: Analysis of real estate development process with an examination of economic feasibility studies, approval processes, project financing, construction, project management, and marketing phases.

BUSI 447.title: Applied Project Management
BUSI 447.description: Project management methodology based on the practices defined by the Project Management Institute, including planning, execution, monitoring, control, and completion.

BUSI 450.title: Intermediate Financial Accounting II
BUSI 450.description: A continuation of the examination of accounting as a means of measurement and as an information system for external reporting purposes.

BUSI 453.title: Advanced Financial Accounting
BUSI 453.description: An examination of advanced financial accounting topics.

BUSI 454.title: Accounting for Management Control and Incentives
BUSI 454.description: Design of accounting systems for facilitating and influencing management decisions, with emphasis on performance evaluation in organizations.

BUSI 455.title: Principles of Auditing
BUSI 455.description: Principles of internal control; audit evidence; sampling and testing; audit reports; standards and responsibilities of the external audit.

BUSI 460.title: Critical Analysis and Forecasting in Real Estate
BUSI 460.description: Delves into two quantitative decision-making methodologies--decision analysis and forecasting--and explores them using a problem-solving framework.
notes: BUSI_V 331 and BUSI_V 444 are also recommended.

BUSI 465.title: Marketing Management
BUSI 465.description: Basic considerations affecting the domestic and international marketing of goods and services.

BUSI 485.title: Taxes and Decision Making
BUSI 485.description: Analysis of business and financial decisions in the presence of taxes.

BUSI 493.title: Strategic Management in Business
BUSI 493.description: A conceptual and practical introduction to the major areas of business strategy with an integrative perspective on managing a business. Includes the analysis of a business and its environment, the development and evaluation of strategic alternatives, and implementation of change.
BUSI 493.prerequisiteText: All of BUSI_V 291, BUSI_V 293, BUSI_V 294, BUSI_V 295, BUSI_V 335, BUSI_V 353, BUSI_V 370, BUSI_V 393, BUSI_V 450

BUSI 497.title: Guided Case Study in Agricultural Real Estate
BUSI 497.prerequisiteText: All of BUSI_V 330, BUSI_V 331, BUSI_V 442, BUSI_V 452

BUSI 498.title: International Business Management
BUSI 498.description: Development of general environmental framework for international business studies by drawing on international and development economics, research into government-business relations and studies in comparative socio-cultural systems and political systems.
BUSI 498.prerequisiteText: BUSI_V 293 and either (a) all of ECON_V 101, ECON_V 102 or (b) ECON_V 309
BUSI 498.corequisiteText: Two of BUSI_V 294, BUSI_V 329, BUSI_V 370, BUSI_V 465

BUSI 499.title: Income Property Guided Case Study
BUSI 499.description: The income property appraisal process, focusing both on valuation techniques as well as general research and report writing skills. All of BUSI_V 330, BUSI_V 331, BUSI_V 442, BUSI_V 452.
